title: Siṅgālaka (2)
text: 1 Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2 Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayam siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || || Evam bhante || || 3 Siyā kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā || na tveva idhekacce sakyaputtiyapaṭiññe pi yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā || || 4 Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino || amhesu appakam pi kataṃ mā nassisatīti || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dvādasamaṃ || || Opamma saṃyuttam || || Tassa uddānaṃ || || Kūṭaṃ Nakhasikhaṃ Kulaṃ || Ukkā Satti Danuggaho || Aṇi Kaliṅgaro Nāgo || Biḷāro dve Siṅgālakā ti || || [page 273] XXI. 1. 7] BHIKKHU-SAṂYUTTA 273 BOOK X BHIKKHU SAṂYUTTAṂ
